sec.title: August 25 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 99)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 25** across American network, King of Swing Benny Goodman live from the Palomar Ballroom for Camel Cigarettes, Bud Abbott & Lou Costello's hysterical drugstore soda jerk comedy, John Mortimer's Old Bailey legal comedy starring Maurice Denham as Horace Rumpole, Nelson Eddy's operatic concerts on *The Electric Hour*, mystic occult serials with *Mandrake the Magician*, and rural mystery on *The Country Sheriff* (1936–1980):
